questions.q: Why did Rebekah move for Jacob to receive the blessing?
choices: She carried the word from the Lord: the elder shall serve the younger
questions.explain: She knew the blessing belonged to Jacob by prophecy, and she took the curse upon herself.

questions.q: What is the blessing Jacob received?
choices: Rulership: nations bow to thee, be lord over thy brethren
questions.explain: The dew of heaven, the fatness of the earth, let people serve thee; cursed be every one that curseth thee.

questions.q: Why did Esau find no place of repentance, though he sought it with tears?
choices: He came too late in the day
He had despised his birthright for one morsel of meat
questions.explain: He that despised the birthright was rejected when he would have inherited the blessing (Hebrews 12:16-17).

questions.q: By what does Esau live, according to his blessing?
questions.explain: Esau's kingdoms have gotten what they have through war, by ever more advanced weaponry.

questions.q: What will happen when Esau's dominion is done?
choices: Jacob comes into power; Esau rules first, then Jacob
questions.explain: This is the time period now, where Esau has the dominion.
